name: sitting foot to chest buttocks stretch
description: A seated stretch pulling the foot toward the chest to open the hips and buttocks.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your back tall and legs extended.
Bend one knee and hold the foot and shin.
Pull the foot gently toward your chest while keeping your spine upright.
Feel the stretch deep in the buttock and hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
